description: Defines classes, structs, enums, and interfaces for E2SM (E2 Service Model) handling in a 3GPP-related software project, including control actions, report services, and message handling.

classes.name: e2sm_control_action_executor
classes.description: Abstract base class for executing RIC control actions, providing interface methods for action identification, support checking, and execution.

classes.name: e2sm_report_service
classes.description: Interface for report services that handle measurement collection and indication message generation.

classes.name: e2sm_control_service
classes.description: Interface for control services managing RIC control actions, including adding executors and executing control requests.

classes.name: e2sm_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling packed E2SM messages, including unpacking and packing various definitions and requests.

classes.name: e2sm_interface
classes.description: Interface for managing E2SM services, including access to packers, supported actions, and control/report services.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the identifier for a specific control action.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a specific control action.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Provides the control action definition used in RAN Function Description.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific RIC control action request is supported.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes a RIC control action asynchronously.

methods.name: collect_measurements
methods.description: Triggers collection of metric measurements in report service.

methods.name: is_ind_msg_ready
methods.description: Checks if an indication message is ready to be sent.

methods.name: get_indication_message
methods.description: Retrieves the collected indication message.

methods.name: get_indication_header
methods.description: Retrieves the indication header.

methods.name: get_style_type
methods.description: Returns the style type ID for the control service.

methods.name: get_control_style_definition
methods.description: Provides the control style definition for RAN Function Description.

methods.name: add_e2sm_rc_control_action_executor
methods.description: Adds a control action executor for a specific action ID.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported.

methods.name: execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_packed_e2sm_action_definition
methods.description: Handles and unpacks a packed E2SM Action Definition.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Handles and unpacks a packed E2SM Event Trigger Definition.

methods.name: handle_packed_ric_control_request
methods.description: Handles and unpacks a packed RIC Control Request.

methods.name: pack_ric_control_response
methods.description: Packs an E2SM RIC Control Response.

methods.name: pack_ran_function_description
methods.description: Packs the RAN function description.

methods.name: get_e2sm_packer
methods.description: Returns a reference to the E2SM handler for packing/unpacking.

methods.name: action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a RIC action is supported.

methods.name: get_e2sm_report_service
methods.description: Returns a report service for a given action definition.

methods.name: add_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Adds a control service to the E2SM interface.

methods.name: get_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Retrieves a control service for a specific control request.
